title: Wife's matching dream of number cubes at Schwandorf church

tellings.quote: and as I came approached the end, dim light, just some lights on the church on the side, I saw your desk.

plain: In 1978, in Schwandorf, Germany, a woman is said to have had a dream that matched her husband's own, a dream of cubes marked with numbers at a church. Her husband, a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, tells Michels what she told him: she walked toward the end of the church in "dim light, just some lights on the church on the side," and there, she said, "I saw your desk." He tells it as two people sharing one dream, which, if true, would mean dreams can carry something from one mind to another.
